result.instructions: Tools for Awtomic, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my subscriptions have a failed billing attempt, and why did the last one fail?"; "Show customer 6012345678901's subscriptions and their next billing dates."; "Skip the next order of subscription 1234567890 for that customer.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Awtomic data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run awtomic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run awtomic_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run awtomic_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. awtomic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: awtomic_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List shop subscriptions
tools.description: List the shop's subscription contracts (id, status, next billing date and more), 100 per page by default. Use reverse to read the newest first. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page. GET /subscriptions.

cursor.description: Paging cursor: the next_cursor of the previous reply. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: awtomic_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: One subscription contract with its lines (products, quantities, prices). Needs the customer id and the subscription id. GET /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_list_customer_subscriptions
tools.title: List a customer's subscriptions
tools.description: List one customer's subscriptions (id, status, next billing date). Set expand_lines to include each subscription's lines; that makes the reply much larger. GET /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

expand_lines.description: Include the subscription lines (larger reply). Default false.

cursor.description: Paging cursor: the next_cursor of the previous reply. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: awtomic_list_billing_attempts
tools.title: List billing attempts
tools.description: A subscription's billing attempts: status (SUCCESS or FAILURE), error code and message, amount, currency and dates. Use it to see why a renewal failed. GET /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/billing-attempts.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

cursor.description: Paging cursor: the next_cursor of the previous reply. Omit for the first page.

reverse.description: Read in reverse order (newest first or oldest first, as Awtomic defines it).

tools.name: awtomic_get_successful_billing_count
tools.title: Get successful billing count
tools.description: How many billing attempts of a subscription succeeded, including those made before a migration from another subscription app. GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/total-successful-billing-count.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_get_origin_order
tools.title: Get subscription origin order
tools.description: The Shopify order that started a subscription (id, name, creation date). GET /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/origin-order.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_get_origin_order_fulfillments
tools.title: Get origin order fulfillments
tools.description: Fulfillment status and the fulfillment orders (status, fulfill-at date) of a subscription's origin order. GET /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/origin-order/fulfillments.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: A customer: name, email, phone, orders count, amount spent, customer-since date, Awtomic overrides and the ids of their subscription contracts. GET /customers/{customerId}.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_get_customer_addresses
tools.title: Get customer addresses
tools.description: A customer's saved addresses and which one is the default. GET /customers/{customerId}/address.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_get_customer_payment_methods
tools.title: Get customer payment methods
tools.description: A customer's payment methods on file: type (card, Shop Pay, PayPal), card brand, last digits, expiry and whether it was revoked. Never the full card number. Use it to spot expired cards before a renewal. GET /customers/{customerId}/payment-methods.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_list_selling_plan_groups
tools.title: List selling plan groups
tools.description: The shop's selling plan groups (subscription plans): name, summary, options, position and whether it is a prepaid plan. Use the ids with awtomic_get_selling_plan_group. GET /shops/selling-plan-groups.

tools.name: awtomic_get_selling_plan_group
tools.title: Get selling plan group
tools.description: One selling plan group with its selling plans (name, prepaid orders, gift support) and the products it applies to. GET /shops/selling-plan-groups/{sellingPlanGroupId}.

selling_plan_group_id.description: Selling plan group id (gId or numeric id) from awtomic_list_selling_plan_groups.

tools.name: awtomic_pause_subscription
tools.title: Pause subscription
tools.description: WRITE: pause a subscription so it is not billed or shipped until it is reactivated (awtomic_reactivate_subscription). A subscription in dunning is taken out of dunning. Awtomic runs the shop's own automations for this event, so the customer may get an email or SMS and webhooks may fire. Awtomic pauses it on its side even if Shopify rejects the pause. POST /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/pause.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_reactivate_subscription
tools.title: Reactivate subscription
tools.description: WRITE: reactivate a paused or cancelled subscription, so billing resumes. A cancelled prepaid subscription cannot be reactivated. Without next_billing_date Awtomic works it out from the subscription's interval; the customer is charged on that date. Awtomic runs the shop's own automations for this event, so the customer may get an email or SMS and webhooks may fire. POST /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/reactivate.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

next_billing_date.description: A date yyyy-mm-dd (read in the shop's time zone, shop renewal billing time applies) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone. Must be later than the end of today.

tools.name: awtomic_skip_next_order
tools.title: Skip next order
tools.description: WRITE: skip a subscription's next order. The subscription must be active; Awtomic moves the next billing date by one interval (each call skips one more order, so do not repeat it). The reply has skipEventId: pass it to awtomic_undo_skip to undo. Awtomic runs the shop's own automations for this event, so the customer may get an email or SMS and webhooks may fire. POST /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/skip.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_undo_skip
tools.title: Undo skip
tools.description: WRITE: undo a skipped order, restoring the billing date from before the skip. Needs the skipEventId returned by awtomic_skip_next_order; Awtomic refuses (409) when the skip can no longer be undone. POST /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/next-billing-date with eventType UNDO_SKIP.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

tools.name: awtomic_set_next_billing_date
tools.title: Set next billing date
tools.description: WRITE: change when a subscription is next billed. The date must be later than the end of today. A paused subscription is reactivated by this call, and one in dunning is taken out of dunning. The customer is charged on the new date. POST /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/next-billing-date.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

next_billing_date.description: A date yyyy-mm-dd (read in the shop's time zone, shop renewal billing time applies) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone. Must be later than the end of today.

tools.name: awtomic_update_frequency
tools.title: Update subscription frequency
tools.description: WRITE: change how often a subscription is billed and delivered, for example every 2 WEEK or every 1 MONTH. Changes every future order of that subscription. POST /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/frequency.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

interval_count.description: Number of interval units between orders (2 + WEEK = every 2 weeks).

tools.name: awtomic_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.title: Cancel a customer's subscription
tools.description: WRITE: cancel one shopper's subscription contract in Awtomic. Billing and shipping stop; a cancelled non-prepaid subscription can be brought back with awtomic_reactivate_subscription. This cancels the shop's customer subscription, not your usefulapi plan. Awtomic runs the shop's own automations for this event, so the customer may get an email or SMS and webhooks may fire. Awtomic cancels it on its side even if Shopify rejects the cancel. Only use it when the user explicitly asks to cancel this subscription, and confirm_cancel must be true. A cancelled prepaid subscription cannot be reactivated. POST /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/cancel.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

confirm_cancel.description: Must be true: you confirm the user asked to cancel this shopper's subscription.

reason.description: Short reason code for Awtomic's analytics, e.g. too_expensive.

details.description: Free-text details of why the subscription is cancelled.

tools.name: awtomic_order_now
tools.title: Charge and order now
tools.description: WRITE: bill the customer's saved payment method and create the subscription's next order immediately, instead of waiting for the billing date. THIS CHARGES THE CUSTOMER. Awtomic refuses (409 ORDER_RECENTLY_PLACED) if the latest billing attempt is pending or succeeded under 10 minutes ago. Set manual_retry only to retry a failed billing attempt. Only use it when the user explicitly asks to place this order now, and confirm_charge must be true. Awtomic runs the shop's own automations for this event, so the customer may get an email or SMS and webhooks may fire. POST /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/order-now.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

confirm_charge.description: Must be true: you confirm the customer is charged now.

tools.name: awtomic_send_payment_update_email
tools.title: Email customer to update payment method
tools.description: WRITE: make Shopify email the customer a link to update their payment method for this subscription. This SENDS AN EMAIL TO THE CUSTOMER each time it is called. Use it for failed payments or expired cards, only when the user asks, and confirm_send must be true. POST /customers/{customerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/send-customer-payment-email.

customer_id.description: Shopify customer id (the number in the Shopify admin customer URL, e.g. 6012345678901). A gid://shopify/Customer/… id is accepted too.

subscription_id.description: Shopify subscription contract id (the SubscriptionId of a subscription, e.g. 1234567890). A gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/… id is accepted too.

confirm_send.description: Must be true: you confirm the user asked to email this customer now.
